result.summary: A residential intersection featuring sidewalks but lacking all basic crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control devices. The wide, unmarked expanse of pavement increases pedestrian exposure and may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential zone.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this intersection, leaving pedestrians with no designated or protected space to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and mid-ground intersection area

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalks end at vertical curbs without ramps, creating a significant barrier for people with disabilities or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk in the center-right

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner of the intersection block the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the curb

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking in the concrete roadway creates tripping hazards and uneven surfaces for crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway surface

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all intersection corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for all users.

interventions.title: All-Way Stop Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs to manage traffic flow and reduce speeds at this residential junction.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly underdeveloped, lacking dedicated sidewalks, marked crossings, or traffic control measures. Pedestrians are forced to share the roadway with vehicles or navigate unpaved grassy areas, significantly increasing exposure and risk.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: There are no sidewalks, forcing pedestrians to walk directly in the travel lane or on uneven grass.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the length of the street on both sides

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked along the left side of the roadway can obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement Surface
hazards.description: The roadway surface shows significant cracking and unevenness, which can be a trip hazard for pedestrians sharing the road.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and middle ground of the roadway

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous paved sidewalks on at least one side of the street to provide physical separation from motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting on existing utility poles to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to eliminate trip hazards and improve the overall safety of the shared space.

result.summary: The image depicts a paved parking area or driveway with no designated pedestrian infrastructure, such as sidewalks or marked crossings. Pedestrians are required to share the space with vehicles, and large parked trucks create potential sightline obstructions.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no sidewalks or marked paths, forcing pedestrians to walk in the same space as vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire paved foreground area

hazards.name: Sightline obstructions
hazards.description: Large parked vehicles can hide pedestrians from moving traffic within the lot.
hazards.location_in_image: Around the silver and black pickup trucks

interventions.title: Designated Walkways
interventions.description: Paint or physically separate a pedestrian path to provide a safe route through the parking area.

interventions.title: Wayfinding and Signage
interventions.description: Install signs to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians and define traffic flow.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection that is largely hostile to pedestrians due to a complete lack of dedicated infrastructure. There are no sidewalks, marked crosswalks, or curb ramps, forcing pedestrians to share a degraded roadway surface with vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians are forced to walk in the roadway alongside vehicle traffic because there are no paved walkways.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the edges of the roadway throughout the scene.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs, increasing exposure risk.
hazards.location_in_image: The center of the intersection where the two roads meet.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The concrete roadway is heavily cracked and uneven, creating significant trip hazards for anyone walking in the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center roadway surface.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb line block visibility between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image where cars are parked along the curb.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide physical separation for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility painted crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps at all corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair or replace the degraded concrete pavement to eliminate trip hazards and improve the walking surface.
